  • 英語名: JK Omuchu ♥

别名

  • じぇいけいおむちゅ

あらすじ

Protagonist’s daughter, Kanna, is highly praised for her excellent grades, athleticism, beauty and friendliness, but in reality she is a sloppy and disrespectful brat who constantly insults her own father and can’t even clean up after herself. Protagonist plans to marry a young and kind busty teacher named Mei, who he hopes will help him improve his parenting skills and teach Kanna some manners. However, he soon discovers that his daughter has a bizarre fetish for wearing diapers and pleasuring herself, which he fears will ruin his chances with Mei. He decides to discipline Kanna harshly before their wedding.

item.title: Reunion ~3kakan Dake no Puchi Dousei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Grand Cru
  • 発売日: 2010-04-30
  • スコア: 6.709999999999999/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Reunion～3日間だけのプチ同棲～
  • 英語名: Reunion 3kakan Dake no Puchi Dousei

あらすじ

Yuji is on summer holiday, but he works hard at his uncle’s house every day. There is a girl who often comes to the house. Her name is Saki and he soon falls in love with her…. Days later, he tells Saki that he loves her and they start dating. However, their relationship suddenly ends…. She does not appear in front of him anymore…. On the last day at his uncle’s house, he sees a girl being chased by some men. He tries to ignore it, but she asks him for help. They somehow run away from them and rush into a deserted house. She is wet through…. To warm their bodies up, they finally sleep together…. After summer holiday, he meets two girls again…. One of them is a rookie teacher and the other is a classmate after suspension….
